crossRefs.note: Then Joshua spoke to Yahweh in the day when Yahweh delivered up the Amorites before the children of Israel. He said in…

people.name: Aijalon
people.line: A Levitical city in Dan, site of Joshua's miracle.

people.name: Michmash
people.line: A town in Benjamin; site of Saul's camp and Jonathan's victory

people.name: Philistia
people.line: An ancient people and region in Canaan

translations.web: They struck the Philistines that day from Michmash to Aijalon. The people were very faint;
translations.bsb: That day, after the Israelites had struck down the Philistines from Michmash to Aijalon, the people were very faint.
translations.kjv: And they smote the Philistines that day from Michmash to Aijalon: and the people were very faint.
translations.asv: And they smote of the Philistines that day from Michmash to Aijalon. And the people were very faint;
